===Levels 1–26: Questing===
Completing [[Monk's Friend]], [[Enlightened Journey]], [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]], and the [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Skrach Uglogwee|Skrach Uglogwee subquest]] of [[Recipe for Disaster]] grants a total of 9,000 experience. This will get the player from level 1 to 26.
